scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: The brush beyond the fire shifts. Fresh tracks lead away from Camp.
A silhouette stops at the edge of the firelight.
Something has disturbed the grass just outside Camp.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: A {species} circles the supplies, keeping beyond the fire.
Tracks end beside the supplies. A {species} is still nearby.
A {species} watches Camp from the tree line.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: A traveler with spare materials asks whether you can part with provisions.
A traveler offers road news and a small exchange.
A traveler pauses by the fire and lays out an offer.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: The traveler you traded with returns and lays out a fresh offer.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: A nest beside the worksite has made the area unsafe to work.
The creatures near the nest keep returning to the worksite.
Movement around the nest has brought the work to a halt.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: A {species} has followed the traces back to Camp.
The tracks now lead toward your fire. A {species} has found Camp.
A {species} appears along the path into Camp.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: A bundle of {material} is caught on the rocks. Some can be recovered carefully; reaching for all of it could spill your {food}.
Loose stones surround a bundle of {material}. You can take your time, risk the climb, or leave it.
Part of a {material} bundle hangs within reach. The rest lies above a narrow ledge.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: You bring the reachable materials down without disturbing your supplies.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: You secure the bundle and return with your provisions intact.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: You bring some materials down, but part of your provisions falls between the rocks.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: The bundle slips away. Some provisions fall as you regain your footing.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: You leave the bundle where it is and return to Camp.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: The recovery ends. Any materials not yet collected are left behind.

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: {town} needs {good}. Bring what you can before the request ends.

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: The goods are counted. Your payment is recorded below.

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: The request has ended. Earlier payments remain yours; the unearned completion offer has passed.

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: {destination} needs {good}. Will you take this request from {town} to them?

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: The request is yours. Bring the required goods to {destination} before it ends.

scenes.speaker: steward
lines: The goods have reached {destination}. Here is the recorded payment.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: Along the road, you find a brief opportunity.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: There is something worth examining here.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: You finish examining the site. The result is recorded below.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: Beyond this entrance, the run keeps its spoils until it is resolved.

scenes.speaker: narrator
lines: The run has ended. These are the spoils retained and left behind.

scenes.speaker: counterhand
lines: Let us see what your goods are worth here.
Check the buyers before you choose a road.
There may be a useful exchange among what you carry.

scenes.speaker: counterhand
lines: Compare the buyers for {good}, then decide whether the journey is worth it.

scenes.speaker: counterhand
lines: {item} costs less at this stall for the current cycle. The exact price and remaining time are below.

scenes.speaker: armourer
lines: Show me your materials, and we will see what can be made.
Choose the pattern first. I will tell you what it needs.
Good work begins with materials you can actually spare.

scenes.speaker: armourer
lines: Your {material} can be used for {pattern}. The cost and resulting item band are below.

scenes.speaker: armourer
lines: This {pattern} is not ready to make. Here is what is still needed.

scenes.speaker: armourer
lines: {item} is finished. The materials spent and the piece produced are recorded below.
